## Control

- **Close with REAPER.** A new switch in Settings, "Close Reaper Control when REAPER quits", closes the app by itself when you quit REAPER in the normal way. It is off by default and applies to every project. If REAPER crashes or is stopped from outside, the app stays open and shows what happened.

## Update the extension

This version comes with a new REAPER extension (1.0.8). Open the app and the setup wizard asks you to update it; restart REAPER afterwards. The switch above only works once the extension is updated.

## Known issues

- The app is not signed yet: macOS and Windows ask for confirmation the first time you open it.
